title: Japan's Longest Loop Trail Opens in Ibaraki
paragraphs: Do you like walking in nature? A new long walking trail is now open in Japan.

The trail is called the Hitachinokuni Long Trail. It is in the north of Ibaraki Prefecture. It goes in a big circle, so it is called a loop trail. It is about 350 kilometers long, and it is the longest loop trail in Japan.
The first part of the trail opened in March 2021. After that, new parts opened every year. The last part opened in September 2026. It is 75 kilometers long.

The trail goes through six cities and towns. It goes past mountains, small villages, rice fields and the sea. There are also many famous places on the trail. For example, people can see Fukuroda Falls, one of the most famous waterfalls in Japan. They can also climb Mount Yamizo. It is 1,022 meters tall, and it is the highest mountain in Ibaraki.
The trail is not very high, and it does not get much snow. So, people can walk on it all year. Autumn is a good time to see the beautiful colors of the leaves.
People do not need to walk the whole trail. They can walk only one part.
It takes less than two hours to get to the area from Tokyo by train.
